name: Do I need to sign up for a service to receive these notes?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to sign up for a service to receive these notes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Access to Daily Real Estate Market Notes is typically provided as part of the client services offered by Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution. It's often included when you're working with an agent on buying or selling property, ensuring you have the most up-to-date information at your fingertips. You may need to provide your contact information and express your interest in receiving these updates, which is a simple process to ensure you're prepared with timely data.
acceptedAnswer.description: These notes are typically part of client services; you may need to provide contact information to receive updates while working with an agent.
